title: Duration Enhancement of the Universal Life Insurance Paid-Up Face
content:
On an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy placed on overloan protection, the protected face receives a duration enhancement that follows the policy year on the exercise date. The enhancement multiplies the protected face before it is rounded to the cent.

**Enhancement scale**

- Policy year **30** or later (the long-enhancement policy year): long duration enhancement, a multiplier of **1.03**.
- Policy year **20** through 29 (at least the mid-enhancement policy year, before the long-enhancement policy year): mid duration enhancement, a multiplier of **1.015**.
- Any other policy year: no enhancement.

Policy year 20 begins on the nineteenth policy anniversary and policy year 30 on the twenty-ninth.

**Boundary readings (hypothetical)**

| Policy year on the exercise date | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 19 | none |
| 20 | 1.015 |
| 29 | 1.015 |
| 30 | 1.03 |
| 34 | 1.03 |

**Effect on a figure (hypothetical).** A face figure of $202650.0000 before the enhancement becomes $205689.75 in policy year 22 and $208729.50 in policy year 31.
